Publication date: 27 July 2026. Fieldwork: 26-27 July 2026.

YouGov Westminster voting intention (change on previous):
- Reform UK: 22% (-1)
- Labour: 22% (+1)
- Conservatives: 21% (+1)
- Greens: 13% (unchanged)
- Lib Dems: 11% (-3)
- Restore Britain: 4% (unchanged)
- SNP: 2% (-1)
- Plaid Cymru: 1% (unchanged)
- Your Party: 1% (+1)
- Others: 2% (+1)

Commentary: Labour reaches its highest point since September 2025, gaining six points from May's low of 16%. The three largest parties are in a virtual tie. Greens down eight points from February peak; Lib Dems record their lowest share of this parliament. (Sample size not stated in fetched content.)
